title: Prescriptions Desk System Card: Travel Refills (Vacation Override)
content:
A patient who is travelling may receive a refill of a Kestrel Prescriptions record before its refill-eligible date as a vacation override refill. The number of days it carries is the vacation override days supply.

## Governing rule

- Every condition of the Prescriptions early refill rules, refill authorization rules and refill-eligible date rules continues to apply.
- The refill consumes one refill.
- The vacation override days supply never exceeds the class's largest vacation override days supply.

## Conditions of the travel refill

A vacation override refill is not dispensed until each confirmed dispensing-error report on the prescription has a corrected remake booked against it on the fill ledger.

The vacation override days supply is fixed only after the prescription's fill ledger shows no owed balance still open, every short fill's owed units having been completed or cancelled.

Put in terms of what the records show: while a confirmed dispensing-error report on the prescription has no corrected remake booked against it, the travel refill is not dispensed; and while an owed-balance entry on the fill ledger is still open, the days supply is not yet fixed.

## Capability of the tool

`record_vacation_override_refill_9f5a083e` dispenses a travel refill of an active prescription ahead of its refill-eligible date and books it on the fill ledger as a vacation override refill. One call books one refill entry with the fill reason `vacation_override`, dispensed complete today at the store holding the prescription and ready for pickup today. It consumes one authorized refill, records the refill sequence number and the refills left, and lowers the prescription's remaining refills by one. After the call the refill is waiting in will-call and the prescription shows one refill fewer.

## How it is invoked

The tool belongs to the agent. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `record_vacation_override_refill_9f5a083e`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `prescription_id` | the reference number of the prescription record being refilled, as returned by the prescription lookup for the verified patient | text identifier |
| `days_supply_dispensed` | the days of therapy the travel refill carries | an integer count of days, no decimals |

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary: `fill_id` (text, the new fill-ledger reference), `prescription_id` (text), `fill_number` (integer refill sequence number), `fill_reason` (text, always "vacation_override"), `days_supply_dispensed` (integer days), `refills_remaining_after` (integer refills left), `ready_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status` (text, "refill_booked" when the entry was written).

## Illustration (hypothetical input)

A call with a `prescription_id` holding 4 remaining refills and a `days_supply_dispensed` of 45 returns `fill_reason` "vacation_override", `days_supply_dispensed` 45, `refills_remaining_after` 3, today's `ready_date` and the status "refill_booked".
